description: Served the beer, and left the cat where he was.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Sold the horn, kept the Norwich answer, and measured the loaf.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Stayed at the back loom, and did not add to the story.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Paid the twopence and the threepence, and said the king is not played this week.
name: William Shakespeare
